Tyrus' Kentucky Derby Picks | Planet Tyrus
The most exciting two minutes in sports is here! WWE legend Tyrus and Louisville ambassador Aron Haddad (Formerly known as Damien Sandow) break down the 2026 Kentucky Derby leaderboard, reveal their "mystic" betting strategy.
The most exciting two minutes in sports is here! WWE legend Tyrus and Louisville ambassador Aron Haddad (Formerly known as Damien Sandow) break down the 2026 Kentucky Derby leaderboard, reveal their "mystic" betting strategy. In this special episode of Planet Tyrus, we dive deep into the pageantry and high stakes of the 152nd Kentucky Derby. Tyrus and Aron review the top contenders for 2026, including the favorite Renegade, and explain why they are putting their money on longshots.
